geopolitics_summary: Ukraine-Russia escalation (Nord Stream sabotage indictment, Russian fuel crisis) and Iran Strait tensions cloud EU gas security; Ireland EU presidency opens policy window amid French political uncertainty.

themes.headline: Germany indicts Ukrainian over Nord Stream sabotage, alleges state backing
themes.why_it_matters: Nord Stream sabotage indictment reignites geopolitical risk around EU-Russia gas relations and pipeline security. Escalates Ukraine-Russia narrative; constrains any future Russian gas export scenarios into EU via pipeline infrastructure.

themes.headline: Ukrainian attacks force Russia to import gasoline, deplete reserves
themes.why_it_matters: Russian fuel production crisis via drone strikes weakens Putin's export capacity and financial resources for energy markets. Tightens global crude/fuel supply; indirect upward pressure on EU power via fuel-switching economics and LNG scarcity if Russia loses export market share.

themes.headline: Iran rejects Macron's maritime mission to secure Strait of Hormuz
themes.why_it_matters: Strait of Hormuz transit risk directly affects global crude and LNG flows; disruption raises EU LNG arb risk and TTF-Henry Hub spreads. Constrains LNG availability to Europe, tightens gas supply and power dispatch margins.

themes.headline: Ireland EU presidency opens six-month policy window amid French political gridlock
themes.why_it_matters: Ireland's Council presidency (H2 2026) before French election may accelerate EU climate/energy regulation (ETS, carbon border rules, green investment). Timing risk: policy decisions could shift power/gas market structure; monitor for accelerated industrial carbon price pass-through or subsidy changes.

themes.headline: Brussels allows green mobility spending waiver post-Iran outbreak of war
themes.why_it_matters: EU fiscal flexibility for EV/renewable infrastructure (EVs, trains, e-bikes) increases demand for grid electricity and reduces transport fuel demand. Shifts demand curve; lowers power spot/forward premia on electrification delta, especially in peak/Cal+1 spreads.

watchlist: Ireland EU presidency agenda announcements (climate/energy regulation, ETS design, carbon border rules).
Iran Strait of Hormuz naval escalation; impact on LNG routing and TTF-HH spreads.
Russian fuel production recovery or further drone strike impacts on crude export capacity.
French government confidence vote outcome; effect on EU policy momentum H2 2026.
